channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Inside the Backrooms: The internet's creepiest place is becoming a tourist attraction
item.description: The Backrooms started as a single eerie image of empty yellow rooms, but internet users turned it into a vast fictional world that feels unsettling.

item.title: Hidden genetic diversity helped inbred brown tree snakes conquer guam
item.description: A notorious snake invasion that devastated Guam's native birds may have succeeded because the reptiles carried hidden genetic advantages, using advanced techniques.

item.title: Scientists trace the surprising origin of human eyes to an ancient cyclops
item.description: Researchers say a tiny one-eyed ancestor from nearly 600 million years ago may have shaped the evolution of every vertebrate eye, including ours.

item.title: The universe can outrun light without breaking Einstein's rules
item.description: Cosmic expansion allows distant galaxies to recede faster than light, while still letting us see ancient light they emitted when much closer.
